description: A paced showcase of the progress animations for a person to watch and review: mana triangle progress bars, the verification map, banner beams and flares, the sidebar orb of triangles and the line of triangles under a repository, paused and draining mana, and a repository space run as triangle blocks. A caption names each scene before it starts, pause steps hold it, and a screenshot after every step lands in the run directory.
notes: Scenes (about 5 minutes), each opened by a caption: 1 Check for updates into the empty folder: signal icon, verification map, the light running around the border, sidebar orb and the line of triangles under the repository, then the finished banner's flare. 2 download at 4 Mbps, held until bytes flow: the Updating banner's mana triangles, then the update view's blinking mana triangles and live speed graph; paused mana; the same download seen from the repository list. 3 cancel: the bubbles sink. 4 a faster download to the end: the completion surge. 5 integrity recheck: shield icon and the hashing map shedding sparkles. 6 quick check: radar icon. 7 repository space Recheck all: a row of triangle blocks filling one by one, then the space banner's flare. Origins needed under testkit/origin/data: synthetic-parts, sibling-synthetic (repo-a, repo-b), synthetic-tiny and synthetic-large; see Local origin in testkit/README.md.

steps.title: Animations showcase
steps.detail: Seven scenes, about five minutes. A caption like this one names each scene before it starts.

steps.title: Scene 1 of 7: Check for updates
steps.detail: Watch the verification map in the banner, the the light running around the border, and the orb and line of triangles on the sidebar repository. The banner flares when the check finishes.

steps.title: Scene 2 of 7: Download
steps.detail: A download held to 4 Mbps. First the Updating banner's triangle bar, then the update view's per-mod triangle bars and the live speed graph.

steps.title: Scene 2 of 7: Paused, then resumed
steps.detail: Pausing the download holds every bar still. After a few seconds it resumes and the triangles blink again.

steps.title: Scene 2 of 7: The download from the repository list
steps.detail: The same download, seen from the main view: the banner bar, plus the orb and line of triangles on the repository in the sidebar.

steps.title: Scene 3 of 7: Cancel
steps.detail: Back in the update view, the download is cancelled. While changes roll back, the bubbles in the bars sink instead of rising.

steps.title: Scene 4 of 7: Download to the end
steps.detail: A faster download that runs to completion. Watch for the surge of light across each bar as it finishes.

steps.title: Scene 5 of 7: Integrity recheck
steps.detail: Every file is hashed again: the shield icon and the verification map filling as files are confirmed.

steps.title: Scene 6 of 7: Quick check
steps.detail: A fast scan for local changes, marked by the radar icon. It is short, so watch closely.

steps.title: Scene 7 of 7: Repository space Recheck all
steps.detail: Four repositories in one space are rechecked in turn. Each one fills its own triangle block, and the space banner flares at the end.

steps.title: End of the showcase
steps.detail: Screenshots of every step are in the run folder.
